ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: OGRE mesh upgrader: converts meshes to the current format, with LOD levels and tangents
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: OgreMeshUpgrader of OGRE 14.6.3, a command line tool that upgrades .mesh files to the current format and can generate levels of detail (module OgreMeshLodGenerator), tangents, edge lists and other mesh changes. It runs without a render system.
